decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric with strong fit to the established collection and prior dedicated presentation, it remains a stable part of the range.
It suits the decorative portfolio, but its lower prominence and more replaceable role within a broad assortment keep rationalization risk at a moderate level.
Its flame-retardant performance and relevance for contract and hospitality projects make it strategically important to retain.
It supports the firm's premium decorative identity and natural-material direction, but as a specialized lower-prominence fabric it still faces meaningful portfolio-pruning risk.
As a recent launch with dedicated presentation and versatile use in both upholstery and curtains, it should be given more time to build market traction.
